attribution.note: Marcus supplies and endorses this tentative causal interpretation of the study.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the tentative wording and causal relationship, scoped to the study’s covert prejudice.

contract.note: The experimental criteria reasonably address the causal mechanism, but the contract expressly makes tentative language scoreable. The plain-reading provision cannot override the policy exclusion for hedged claims.

evidence.note: The pre-cutoff original preprint reports significantly stronger stereotypes at higher experimentally introduced AAE feature density. This supports the underlying mechanism, without making Marcus’s hedged statement scoreable.

reviews.rationale: Marcus qualifies the causal interpretation with tentative language. Policy excludes such claims from scoring, even when experimental evidence supports the proposed mechanism. The case is intact; no abstention is warranted.
